analysis: Natural fluctuation direct response-space anchor for RPE1 IGC
calibration_source_rule: frozen outer-train source list intersected with the 1,755 measured source genes for which a control-expression fluctuation vector exists; q remains centered by the original full frozen-train mean

estimators.raw_cov: negative control-cell sample covariance Cov(X_target, X_response)
estimators.resid_corr: negative correlation after the same residualization
estimators.resid_cov: negative covariance after joint OLS removal of library proxy and 20 global expression PCs

geometry.artifact_safe: all pairwise metrics are computed separately within each held-out fold; no cross-fold pairs
geometry.bootstrap: global perturbation-source multinomial weights reused across five within-fold groups

optional_estimators: SGS is deferred until primary and residualized results establish signal.

metrics: sign agreement among top 10% absolute truth coordinates
nulls: within-fold target permutation (200 draws; targetwise expected null and empirical p)

residualization.library_proxy: row sum of existing normalized/log-transformed expression matrix
residualization.pca: sklearn PCA, centered full 8749-gene normalized control expression, randomized solver
residualization.regression: one joint OLS design [intercept, standardized library proxy, standardized PC1-PC20]

strict_trans_panel: intersection of the five frozen fold-local strict-trans panels

verdict_gates.conservative_rule: Partial/strong support requires a residualized estimator; a signal confined to raw covariance is treated as state-confounded and does not support a natural anchor.
